commands.name: apply

options.name: --allow-out-of-order
options.description: Apply migrations whose version sorts before one that  already ran.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Take the lock and validate the plan, but roll nothing  out.

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment to target, as named in sqlexec.json.

options.name: --ignore-checksums
options.description: Treat edits to already-applied migrations as warnings  instead of errors.

options.name: --lock-timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the deployment lock before giving up. Default: 120.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to sqlexec.json. Defaults to the nearest one,  searching upwards from the working directory.

options.name: --to
options.description: Stop after this version instead of applying everything pending.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt. Required when deploying  to a protected environment from CI.

commands.description: Apply pending migrations to an environment.

commands.name: env
add

options.name: --connection
options.description: Literal connection string. Use ${VAR} placeholders for anything secret.

options.name: --connection-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the whole  connection string. Preferred: no secret reaches the project file.

options.name: --description
options.description: Free text describing the environment, for humans  reading the project file.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an environment that already carries this  name.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to sqlexec.json. Defaults to the nearest one, searching upwards from the working directory.

options.name: --protected
options.description: Require an explicit confirmation (or --yes) before apply deploys here.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Engine this environment targets: sqlserver, mysql, postgresql, oracle, or a plugin id.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag this environment accepts, so migrations named  .+tag reach it. Repeat for several tags.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the environment, as it will be passed to  --env.
